verified_good_products.title: FRP Dome Shelters
verified_good_products.description: Global Fibrotech make the FRP Dome Shelter prefabricated structures in various sizes as per customer requirement at very effective price.Product Details:The design of the Global Fibrotech allows it to be easily configured in many different ways. By adding or replacing panels, you can tailor the structure to your needs. Custom designed panels can be provided for specialized applications. Portable Global Fibrotech are made of panels which can easily be assembled and dismantled any number of times without any damage or loss to the panels. The high impact resistance of fibre glass makes it feasible to relocate any number of times. Fire retardant The resins used in making the Global Fibrotech are fire retardant. Hence it minimises the threat of fire. Insulation Global Fibrotech Shelter Panels have high density foam, sandwiched inside which makes these shelters highly insulated Environment friendly Global Fibrotech Shelter are environment friendly, both as a product and in manufacturing. Zero maintenance Global Fibrotech Shelter need no maintenance. The shelters don't react to acids or alkali. They are termite proof, rust proof and the exteriors need no painting. Just occasional washing the surface keeps them looking like new. Customisable design (size and looks) There are innumerable designs that can be made using these panels. Two shelters can be connected together, thru the dormers, hence can lead to a permutation to suit the requirements .The length of the shelters has no limits. They can be made as long as required. There are two widths available i.e. 20.4 feet and 26.2 feet. These shelters can also be made in any colour and texture too, depending upon the requirements. Highly durable The shelf life of a fiber glass panel is very high as it doesn't decompose ever. It also emits an inert behaviour which makes it highly durable and weather resistant. Energy efficient There is no maintenance required for a Global Fibrotech Shelters other than occasional washing. Consequently, on maintenance savings alone, your savings over a 5-year period will be 25% and over a 20-year period will be 100%.The shape of the dome structure with its low surface area to volume ratio automatically reduces by 30% the amount of cubic meters necessary to be heated or cooled. The polyurethane foam used in the dome has the highest insulation value in use in building construction today. Because of the foam placement within the walls, the extreme insulating properties of the dome makes it incredibly energy efficient - 50% - 70% savings over conventional structures.No other structure in the market today can make that claim. High wind resistant The aerodynamic design makes the Global Fibrotech Shelters highly resistant to strong winds. Light weight UV proof The resin used is UV proof that makes the shelters protected from UV rays.
